sentences.en: My ex shares custody of the children.

sentences.en: His ex - wife has upped the ante in her alimony suit against him.

sentences.en: He felt deeply resentful towards his ex - wife .

sentences.en: He was stigmatised as an ex - convict.
sentences.vi: Anh ta đã bị kỳ thị như một người từng bị kết án.

sentences.en: The sum was paid ex gratia.
sentences.vi: Số tiền đã được thanh toán ex gratia.

sentences.en: I bumped into my ex in town.
sentences.vi: Tôi tình cờ gặp người yêu cũ trong thị trấn.

sentences.en: Is she still in touch with her ex?
sentences.vi: Cô ấy có còn liên lạc với người yêu cũ không?

sentences.en: He was present at the meeting ex officio.
